    Classic Tee

    The timeless AS Colour Classic Tee, ideal for printing with its regular fit and heavy weight 6.5 oz, 22-singles 100% combed cotton. Built to last with neck ribbing, side seams, shoulder-to-shoulder tape, and double needle hems, plus preshrunk fabric for minimal shrinkage.

    Outlet items are excluded from THEDEAL.
    Outlet price applies to the selected colour only.
    Outlet items are not eligible for refunds or exchanges.
    Online only, Outlet items are not available in stores.

    shipping_chunk-1:
    We ship nationwide in the United States and Canada. Most in stock & credit-approved orders received by 2pm local time where order is being shipped from, will be processed the same day.
    shipping_chunk-2:
    There may be a slight delay during sale periods due to high volumes. For more info see our shipping page.
    • Free shipping for orders over $500 (Wholesale) and $125 (Retail)
    returns_chunk-1:
    If you're not satisfied with your purchase, please return the items for an exchange or credit.
    returns_chunk-2:
    All returns must be made within 30 days of the invoice date with a completed returns form - for full terms and conditions see our returns page.
    tab_Care Instructions:
    Please note Army/Coal can be susceptible to fading/colouration variance. Also, particular sunblocks or deodorants mixed with high levels of sun exposure/body sweat can cause bleaching of the dyes in these colours - please consider when ordering.
    care_chunk-1:
  • Machine wash cold with like colours.
  • Do not bleach.
  • Do not tumble dry.
  • Do not dry clean.
  • Do not iron if printed.
  • Line dry in shade.

    Description

    The timeless AS Colour Classic Tee, ideal for printing with its regular fit and heavy weight 6.5 oz, 22-singles 100% combed cotton. Built to last with neck ribbing, side seams, shoulder-to-shoulder tape, and double needle hems, plus preshrunk fabric for minimal shrinkage.

    Details
    Fit
    Regular
    Fabric
    Heavy weight, 6.5 oz, 22-singles, 100% combed cotton (heathers 15% viscose)
    Construction
    Neck ribbing, side seamed, shoulder to shoulder tape, double needle hems, preshrunk to minimise shrinkage
    Embellishment
    Suited for screen printing, DTG and embroidery – Click here for more info

    Shipping and Returns
    Shipping
    We ship nationwide in the United States and Canada. Most in stock & credit-approved orders received by 2pm local time where order is being shipped from, will be processed the same day. There may be a slight delay during sale periods due to high volumes. For more info see our shipping page.
    • Free shipping for orders over $500 (Wholesale) and $125 (Retail)
    We ship nationwide in the United States and Canada. Most in stock & credit-approved orders received by 2pm local time where order is being shipped from, will be processed the same day.
    There may be a slight delay during sale periods due to high volumes. For more info see our shipping page.
    • Free shipping for orders over $500 (Wholesale) and $125 (Retail)
    Returns
    If you're not satisfied with your purchase, please return the items for an exchange or credit. All returns must be made within 30 days of the invoice date with a completed returns form - for full terms and conditions see our returns page.

    Care Instructions
  • Machine wash cold with like colours.
  • Do not bleach.
  • Do not tumble dry.
  • Do not dry clean.
  • Do not iron if printed.
  • Line dry in shade.
  • Made in Bangladesh.
    • Machine wash cold with like colours.
    • Do not bleach.
    • Do not tumble dry.
    • Do not dry clean.
    • Do not iron if printed.
    • Line dry in shade.
    • Made in Bangladesh.

    Please note Army/Coal can be susceptible to fading/colouration variance. Also, particular sunblocks or deodorants mixed with high levels of sun exposure/body sweat can cause bleaching of the dyes in these colours - please consider when ordering.
